decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already fully records wallet access for ticket holding and transfer of active Big Block prize tickets to the secondary buyer.
The same-message MODIFY already records that active prize tickets transfer with the NFT to the secondary buyer.
The same-message MODIFY already records that wallet access is required to hold prize tickets while preserving wallet-free fiat minting.
The same-message MODIFY already updates the eligible population to include secondary buyers who receive active tickets with the NFT.
The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the FAQ statements about wallet requirements and transfer of active prize tickets.
The same-message MODIFY already records that secondary buyers receiving active Small Block tickets are eligible holders.
The same-message MODIFY already records that secondary buyers receiving active Big Block tickets are eligible holders.
Transferring active tickets with NFT ownership does not necessarily change which ticket counters or identity attributes the NFT metadata must expose.
The source changes prize-ticket holding and transfer rules, not the amount, trigger, recipient, timing, or payout mode of the referral commission.
Prize-ticket ownership and wallet requirements do not change the primary mint price or allocation of mint proceeds.
The source changes active-ticket holding and transfer, but does not change the winner announcement, claim interaction, or payout method.
Transfer of active prize tickets to a secondary buyer does not change the secondary royalty amount, enforcement, visibility, or proceeds allocation.
